card.name: End of 'overdosage' in overdose sections
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'overdosage' (overdos|age) in OVERDOSAGE sections of drug labels. It also fires on 'studies' after 'animal' in the same sections.

modes.label: overdosage ending
modes.description: The closing 'age' of the split word overdosage, in statements about reported cases or effects.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE No cases of human overdos<<age>> with eplerenone have been reported

modes.label: animal studies
modes.description: The word 'studies' right after 'animal' in overdose text.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE In animal<< studies>> with Eulexin ® alone, signs
